name: JupyterLab
purpose: Notebooks let you run code step by step and keep results, charts and notes together, which helps when exploring data.
version_guidance: Install the latest release that supports your Python version. Record the installed version in your research log.

windows.text: Start it. It opens in your browser.

macos.text: Start it. It opens in your browser.

linux.text: Start it. It opens in your browser.

windows.expected: One line: jupyterlab and its version, for example jupyterlab 4.x.y. To start it, run: jupyter lab

macos.expected: One line: jupyterlab and its version, for example jupyterlab 4.x.y. To start it, run: jupyter lab

linux.expected: One line: jupyterlab and its version, for example jupyterlab 4.x.y. To start it, run: jupyter lab

common_problems.solution: Your virtual environment is probably not active, or the package went into another Python. Activate the environment, then install again with python -m pip install.
Activate your virtual environment, or run python -m jupyter lab instead.

common_problems.problem: A notebook cannot find a library you installed
common_problems.solution: The notebook uses another Python. Start JupyterLab from the terminal where your .venv is active.

manual_review: The install command is the official pip command, run as python -m pip.
Verification command prints a label before the version so the check is specific to this package. It uses the package's standard __version__ attribute and is not quoted from the official page.
